troubleshooting.terminal_not_connecting: Check if ttyd is running on port 7681, verify server credentials, check network connectivity
troubleshooting.tabs_not_working: Ensure tabs array is properly initialized, check localStorage for corruption
troubleshooting.ai_not_responding: Verify Open WebUI endpoint is accessible, check API key if required, ensure Qwen model is loaded
troubleshooting.widgets_not_saving: Check localStorage quota, verify JSON serialization, check browser console for errors
troubleshooting.drag_not_working: Ensure terminal has 'draggable' class, check if terminal-area bounds are correct

best_practices.server_management: Use descriptive names and icons, enable persistence for important servers, organize by project or environment
best_practices.conversation_management: Mark successful conversations, create memories for important learnings, use time filters to find recent work
best_practices.script_organization: Use clear names, add comments, test before auto-run, backup important scripts
best_practices.widget_usage: Keep widgets small and focused, use custom HTML for complex needs, position strategically
best_practices.ai_interaction: Be specific in questions, provide context, use code blocks for code-related queries, save successful solutions as memories
